narrative:
Huron County has 35,656 registered voters, with 57.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 27.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 14.2%, a pronounced Republican lean of 13.7 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.9% of registrants.
